description: email.rs: HeaderPropertyRequest stores both original: String (the full 'header:Subject:asText' string) and name_lower: String (the lowercased name segment) and form: HeaderForm and all: bool. The original field is used only to re-insert into the response map (line 479: map.insert(req.original.clone(), extracted)). Storing it in the struct forces a String allocation per parsed header property. Since the original is the input to parse_header_property, and the call site has the original string available, the caller could pass it directly at map.insert() time. The struct's data members (name_lower, form, all) are sufficient for the extraction logic — original is extraneous. Removing original reduces the struct size and eliminates one String allocation per parsed header property request.
title: HeaderPropertyRequest.original stores full property string — redundant with parse input
